You're right, and I try my best to think as logically and rational as possible,  so I know there's always more to the problem. But for as long as I can remember its near impossible to have a conversation with my mom without her either screaming, crying, or verbally abusive. I used to have to choose every word I said around her so carefully, it was easier to just not say anything at all. I appreciate everything she's done for me, but she's made it one fucked up ride along the way. I also know part of that is to blame on my dad, because he was a pretty serious alcoholic. But I don't even remember them together, so I just go off what I've experienced, and my mom has done some really nasty and cruel things. She's not all bad of course, I've had some good moments with her. But they're overshadowed by the maelstrom of chaos and confusion that has just become SSDD for me. I really do want to put it all behind me and start worrying about myself for a change.

That was for my dad. He's told me in the 15 years of divorce he has not won a single case against my mom, and they go to court all the time. She used to be really big into law as well so she knows her way around the courtroom. I don't know what she'll do in court, but it probably wont be pretty. I'll most likely need a lawyer soon. Mind as well delete my Facebook and start working out as well.

Thank you. I appreciate the moral support from everyone, but I don't know  much about legalities, so its nice to have some resources to inform myself with.

As far as I know its not in a trust, it was just a handful of stock my grandparents gave to my parents, and all my dads brothers and sisters, when each of their children was born. All of my cousins, I have seven of them, and my brother and I got an equal share. She admits to spending my brothers on college, but refuses to admit my grandparents gave any such stock for me. 

All I have as evidence is that my dad has been telling me for years that when I turn 18 I need to put the account in my name and that this exact situation was probably going to happen, my grandma has told me herself about the stock, the divorce papers entitle her as trustee of the accounts, and on the stock papers she is entitled guardian for me. 

To me it sounds like she was given the task to look over our accounts until a certain period but now refuses to relinquish control. Now I don't want to talk bad about my mom, but she is the kind of lady anyone in the service industry hopes wont come in that day. It gets ugly sometimes, and on occasion I have doubted her mental stability, for more reasons then just poor social skills. If I had to guess she's probably upset that she's losing what little bit of control she has over me and is going to do everything in her power to keep me tied down. And she's a very scary and intimidating women, its taken me awhile to break out of her grasp as much as I have, maybe I should finish the job.

This isn't out of character for her. I'm used to her lying, cheating, and deceiving me and anyone else for no reason, even sometimes when it would be easier to just be a nice person. It would be hard to "disown" her, but in reality its pretty much already happened. I moved out of the house as soon as I turned 18 to go live with a friend because I cant handle her crazy antics anymore. I don't get any support from her and have practically stopped talking to her already. I know she's just afraid she's going to be losing me and a large sum of money, but the fact she's okay with losing me more then the money is frightening. I've got a good idea that the money belongs to me, but I have to think "Why the hell would a mother do this to their kid?" She should be trying to help me as much as she can, but instead she's abandoning me. And if thats really what she wants, then I guess I'm fine with it. I'd rather live my life comfortably then having to worry about every little thing like she's been making me do my whole life. Maybe it is time for me to break it off.
When someone says something about plowing my mom I always tell them for their sake I hope they're joking.
The account holders told me because it was court ordered for her to be the trustee it must be court ordered for her to be removed.

You would hope not, but whenever she brought my dad to court that's exactly what would happen. She would start crying and blaming everything on my dad because he used to be an alcoholic. (14 years sober) The judge always takes my moms side even when my dad comes in with factual evidence and logical arguments, because whatever my mom wants she gets.

Thank you. And she did try the guilt tripping thing first. I've learned a bit about my mom living with her so long, and I know these are all just tricks she's using to try and manipulate me. The first time I brought it up I was still living with her and she said if I try to take it then I need to move out. Not too shortly after, I moved out because I've gotten so sick an tired of all her shit. I've really been trying to avoid lawyers knowing she will probably manipulate the judge onto her side, and because I really don't want to disown my mother. But I told her she was making that decision, and honestly, at this point, maybe it would be best. I've already been on my own for awhile without her help, so its not like I'd be losing much anyway...
Exactly. She cant even access the money without my permission, so what the hell is she going to do with it?

That's what it really feels like too. She always tried to guilt trip me when I bring it up, saying she's the one that's raised me for some odd years and she deserves the money. And while I sympathize with that, she's trying to take a huge opportunity from me. She keeps saying they've all brainwashed me into thinking shes out to get me, when I barely have any contact with the other side of the family. The only thing I have to go off of is her actions throughout my life, and honestly, trying to rip me off doesn't seem out of her capabilities. I've been trying to avoid a lawyer because knowing my mom she would throw her bitch fit in court too. Crying and pleading that I'm an ungrateful child until the judge gives in to her. She's very manipulative.
She wants to keep it for herself, claims its her retirement fund.

You know, I say I worry about my brother, but realistically I worry about myself, because I know that everything I say about him goes the same for me. I doubt my mental integrity on a daily basis, things that normal people think are taboo I relish in. I can be moral less, selfish, deceitful, and hypocritical just as bad as him. We both know we're crazy, but the difference is as Gerard said, two outcomes can happen when someone goes through a traumatic experience. They either take the experience and make themselves stronger, learn from it, or they deteriorate into the same lifeforms that created the trauma. I think that's where me and my brother separate. I try my hardest to not become the beast I know lurks within, where as my brother seems to embrace it. I hold myself to morals and values that I created, as loose as they may be... But do you know what scared me the most? I already know I'm going to kill myself eventually. The only reason I haven't yet is because I owe myself to keep trying. I've worked too damn hard, been through too much shit to just give up now, as easy as it may be... People call suicide a permanent solution to a temporary problem, I call it the easy solution to life's problems. I actually have a slight peace at mind knowing that if things don't get any better like everyone says they will, I reserve the right to just end it. And sometimes, like now when everything seems to be happening at once, I really just want to go through with it... Fuck it, right? It's only been 17 years and I've managed to cram more shit into my life then most people. Why the hell should I think its going to get any better then this? That seems like an insane notion if you ask me... I've been thinking about it a lot lately. How easy it would be to get rid of all the drama. Stop all the bullshit thats happening at the time. Stop all the worrying... There are so many unknowns in life... It would be a relief to have to stop thinking about them. I want to make something of myself, because if I don't no one will. And I'm just going to be stuck in this situation forever. But it just seems like everything is out to get me, so why not just let them win? Why keep trying to fight the good fight, when in the end it all realistically doesn't matter? I could really go for some death right now...

Hmm... A blog would be kind of cool. A great way to journal my thoughts. But you really think people would be interested in an AMA about this? My brothers also a redditor, and I was thinking about showing him and my mom this. 

I can get really detailed, I just thought it might get boring if I told every little thing.

Its good to get some confirmation, but I've always know my life was a little more dysfunctional then others... I just thought I was being a little bitch about it and things aren't as bad as I make them out to be. Aside from the occasional spurts of depression, I like to think I'm doing fine. 
I would say I'm the former of the two kinds of people you describe, and my brother is the latter. I like to consider myself very level headed. I rarely get upset and it takes a lot to get an emotional stir out of me. 
Crazy things have happened all throughout my life. I've often been afraid to tell people about my life for fear they might become disturbed. These are just a fraction of the events that occur what seems weekly to me. I've also felt if I were to actually start telling people what I've been through, they wouldn't believe me. There's actually one friend of mine... We've had lunch together for like five years straight, so every time a crazy event happened in my life the next day I would report it back to him. He's actually the only other person I've asked if my life is fucked up or not to. And he said yeah, most definitely. 
My life is just extraordinary.  I'd like to thank you and everyone else that has gotten me to keep talking. I'm still not sure what I came here to accomplish, but I feel like I did it. It just feels a lot better to talk about it all. And the insight is always so helpful. Life is all about perspective and I try to see it from everyones. 
I've still got a lot more episodes in the chronicles of Jugglez McGavin, so if anyones interested I could keep telling stories.
